releases.notes:
## Diet – AppleSeed Edition 2.0.3.1

Patched 2.0.3 (NeoForge 1.21.1) fixing a dedicated-server startup crash: a
client-only KeyMapping was initialized during mod construction, tripping
NeoForge's RuntimeDistCleaner ("invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER"). The common
menu registry was moved out of the client-only class; clients are unaffected.

- Modified fork of: https://github.com/Fallenflower-modder/Diet---AppleSeed-Edition
- Source for this build (LGPL-3.0): https://github.com/derpack-org/Diet---AppleSeed-Edition-fix
- LGPL-3.0, not relicensed. Menu id unchanged (appleseed:diet) → compatible with stock 2.0.3 clients.

Artifact: appleseed-2.0.3.1-1.21.1.jar
